spec.concept: Reentrancy risk: state updated after an external call lets a callback repeat the withdrawal
spec.scene: Flat technical diagram on a deep navy background: a contract block sends an arrow to an external contract, and a looping amber arrow returns to the first block, showing a callback before the balance is cleared. Minimal line icons, calm and precise, with a clear space for overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a contract calling an external contract, with a looping arrow showing a callback re-entering before the balance is cleared.

spec.concept: Price oracle manipulation: a trust boundary where attackers can move the price inputs a protocol relies on
spec.scene: Technical card on a deep navy background showing a simple diagram of a price feed passing through a gate into a lending contract, with an amber line marking the trust boundary and a bold short headline in white.
spec.overlay_text: An oracle is a trust boundary
spec.alt_text: Brand card with a navy background and an amber line marking a trust boundary between a price feed and a lending contract, with the text An oracle is a trust boundary.

spec.concept: A Sentinel Grove review reports each finding with its severity, root cause and a recommended fix, presented as a clear, structured brand card.
spec.scene: Solid deep navy background with a simple amber accent line and a minimal grove-inspired shield motif. The overlay text sits centered in white with generous spacing.
spec.overlay_text: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber accent line and white text reading: its severity, its root cause and a recommended fix.

spec.concept: Authorization should check the immediate caller, not the original transaction sender
spec.scene: Technical diagram style card: a chain of three connected contract nodes on a dark navy background, with the origin node at the left and an amber highlight on the final node to show the caller that must be checked. Clean lines, calm and precise, no people.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of three linked contract nodes on a navy background, with the last node highlighted in amber to show the immediate caller being checked for authorization.

spec.concept: Unprotected Ether withdrawal caused by missing caller authorization
spec.scene: A calm, minimal brand card: a navy background with a vault door left slightly open, and a single amber key outline hovering beside the lock to suggest access control. Clean geometric shapes, ample empty space for the overlay text.
spec.alt_text: Navy card with an ajar vault door and an amber key outline beside the lock, with the text: without a caller check.

spec.concept: Credibility through a simple, factual statement of audit experience from a smart contract audit firm
spec.scene: Clean brand card with a deep navy background, a thin amber accent line beneath the overlay text, and a minimal outline of a grove tree with a small shield motif in white. Calm, precise layout with generous spacing.
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber accent line and a white outline of a tree with a shield, reading: completed 12 smart contract audits.
